parameters.content:
## Trellis Static Ad — v1

Generates ONE publish-ready static ad image + copy, with a self-check pass on the rendered on-image text.

**In:** POST /webhook/trellis-static-ad-generate
```
{ job_id, branch, message,
  target_segment, platform,
  aspect_ratio, setting, style_notes }
```
**Out:** job row -> status `awaiting_approval`, with `frame_url`, `media_urls` (1 item), `caption`, `frame_prompt` set.

Approval + publish happen in the Trellis app (Video Ad Lab), which hands off to the existing B3 social publisher webhook (`trellis-social-publish`) with `media_type: 'image'`.

### Setup
1. Credentials — reuse the same 3 as Trellis-Video-Ad-Frame-v1:
   • **Sproutify Trellis** (Supabase) — id `IkIpi5m4OmJ9DvBS`
   • **Gemini API** (Query Auth) — replace `REPLACE_GEMINI_CRED`
   • **Supabase Storage (legacy eyJ service role)** (Header Auth) — replace `REPLACE_SUPABASE_STORAGE_CRED`
2. Prerequisite SQL (Hub, run once — idempotent):
```sql
ALTER TABLE video_ad_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS format TEXT;
ALTER TABLE video_ad_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS media_urls JSONB DEFAULT '[]';
ALTER TABLE video_ad_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS caption TEXT;
```
3. Activate, then point the Video Ad Lab's static-ad action at `https://n8n.sproutify.app/webhook/trellis-static-ad-generate`.

This workflow STOPS at `awaiting_approval`. It does not publish anything.

### Why copy comes before the image
The headline has to exist BEFORE we ask Nano Banana to render it onto the picture, so **Generate Copy** runs first and **Parse Copy** builds the final image prompt around the returned headline.

### Why the QA loop
Nano Banana sometimes garbles on-image text. **Vision QA** re-reads its own output; if the text isn't fully legible it retries **once** with a stronger prompt (`Track Frame Attempt` uses `$runIndex` the same way F1's poll loop does), then proceeds regardless so the job never stalls waiting for a perfect render — a human approves it either way.

nodes.name: Upsert Job Record
nodes.notes: Insert on first run. On a resubmit the row already exists and this 409s harmlessly - onError lets it pass through, mirrors Trellis-Video-Ad-Frame-v1.

nodes.name: Lookup Brand Profile
nodes.notes: Prefix match so both bare slugs and domain keys in brand_profiles resolve. If nothing matches, downstream falls back to branch name + 'friendly' tone.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $('Prepare Copy Prompt').item.json.copy_prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.8, maxOutputTokens: 500 } }) }}

nodes.name: Generate Copy
nodes.notes: gemini-flash-latest, same model id used by Trellis-Video-Ad-Frame-v1.

nodes.name: Parse Copy
nodes.notes: Defensive JSON parse: raw JSON.parse -> regex-extracted {...} block -> hand-built fallback from the raw text. Never throws.

nodes.name: Track Frame Attempt
nodes.notes: $runIndex is this node's own execution count within the workflow run - same idiom F1 uses in 'Bump Progress'. attempt=1 first pass, attempt=2 on the single retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.image_prompt + ($json.attempt > 1 ? ' Regenerate this image with clearer, fully legible, correctly spelled on-image text than the previous attempt.' : '') }] }], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['IMAGE'], imageConfig: { aspectRatio: $json.aspect_ratio } } }) }}

nodes.name: Generate Image
nodes.notes: Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image). Returns inlineData base64 in candidates[].content.parts[].

nodes.name: Extract Image
nodes.notes: Keeps base64 in json (not just binary) so Vision QA downstream can reuse it without a re-download step.

nodes.name: Upload Image to Storage
nodes.notes: Same episode-assets bucket as Trellis-Video-Ad-Frame-v1, under a static-ads/ prefix. MUST use the legacy eyJ... JWT service role key - upsert:false + a randomised filename avoids the UPDATE RLS policy on Storage, same as Frame v1.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a quality checker for a marketing static ad image. Look closely at the attached image. Is ALL text in the image fully rendered, correctly spelled, and completely readable with nothing cut off or garbled? Reply with exactly one line: the single word YES or NO, followed by a short reason.' }, { inlineData: { mimeType: $('Extract Image').item.json.mime, data: $('Extract Image').item.json.base64 } }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0, maxOutputTokens: 200 } }) }}

nodes.name: Vision QA
nodes.notes: One multimodal Gemini call reading back its own generated image. gemini-flash-latest is multimodal, so no new model id is introduced.

nodes.name: QA Passed?
nodes.notes: True when QA said YES, OR we've already used our one retry (attempt >= 2) - proceeds either way so the job never stalls. False loops back to Track Frame Attempt exactly once.

nodes.name: Update: Awaiting Approval
nodes.notes: Terminal state for this workflow. media_urls is written as a JSON.stringify'd array via the Supabase node - after first run, confirm in the table editor that the column stores a real JSON array and not a double-encoded string; if PostgREST stores it as a scalar string, switch this field to a raw HTTP PATCH node with Content-Type: application/json instead.
